title: Rephix 0.4 text-only recovery protocol, version 2
registered: 2026-11-08, committed alone before any v2 final-split run; v2 final seeds 201-205 have never been run
supersedes: version 1 (examples/text_recovery_protocol.json). v1 final runs serve as development data for v2; they are reported as a pilot in docs/TEXT_RECOVERY_RESULTS.md, including runs contaminated by mid-run code changes
changes_from_v1: class test adds held-out validation contexts and is two-sided (alpha/2 per tail; under-dispersed outputs are rejected)
float32 backbone features use span tolerance 1e-5 (LayerNorm hyperplane); new LayerNorm case head-tiny-gpt2
private directory is mode 000 during recovery and reload; oracle preloaded behind a loopback relay
target parameters drawn from a per-run secret, published only after recovery
corpus and prompt pools read from docs at corpus_commit
status expectations are allowed-status sets; main in-class cases require at least 4 of 5 recoveries (each run has about a 1% false-rejection rate)
experiment runs from an immutable git worktree at the registration commit

success_criteria.S1_status: every final run's status is in its case's allowed set; an error must contain the case's error_contains text
success_criteria.S2_recovery_rate: cases with min_recovered have at least that many recovered runs out of 5
success_criteria.S3_accuracy: every recovered run with canonical truth has canonical_relative_l2_error <= 0.10
success_criteria.S4_self_report: every such run has canonical_relative_l2_error <= 2.5 * reported_relative_standard_error
success_criteria.S5_coverage: coordinate-pooled 95% interval coverage over such runs lies in [0.90, 0.99]
success_criteria.S6_behaviour: every recovered run except ngram-blind-spot has test_mean_total_variation <= 0.02 on held-out contexts disjoint from queries
success_criteria.S7_baseline: MLE canonical error below the plug-in baseline in at least 80% of such runs
success_criteria.S8_consistency: median ratio of canonical error at 8000 to 32000 samples per context (paired seeds) lies in [1.5, 2.7] (theory: 2)
success_criteria.S9_no_false_recovery: no out-of-class (order3, mlp, perturbed), greedy, undeclared-output or underdetermined run is recovered_in_class
success_criteria.S10_isolation: zero denied or private opens, recovery spawned only the relay, no chmod attempts, every reload probe audited with no spawned processes, max reload |log p difference| <= 1e-9
success_criteria.S11_blind_spot: ngram-blind-spot is recovered in >= 4/5 runs while its trigger-context mean TV is >= 0.3 (demonstrates that class membership is assumed, not proven)

environment_variables.REPHIX_MODELS: directory with pinned snapshots tinyllama-15M and smollm2-135m

cases.name: ngram-moderate
cases.purpose: peakier target (logit scale 1.5); v1 recovered 3/5 at this budget

cases.name: head-tiny-qwen2
cases.purpose: private head on a random public Qwen2 (RMSNorm) backbone

cases.name: head-tiny-gpt2
cases.purpose: private head on a random public GPT-2 (LayerNorm with bias) backbone

cases.name: ngram-peaked
cases.purpose: boundary: improbable outputs (logit scale 2.5) at practical budget

cases.name: ngram-corpus
cases.purpose: boundary: natural English character model with rare characters

cases.name: ngram-order3-target
cases.purpose: out of class: target uses a third previous token

cases.name: ngram-mlp-target
cases.purpose: out of class: added tanh hidden layer

cases.name: head-perturbed-backbone
cases.purpose: out of class: private fine-tuned backbone differs from the public prior

cases.name: ngram-undeclared-output
cases.purpose: boundary: target emits a string outside the declared classes
cases.error_contains: not exactly one public class string

cases.name: ngram-underdetermined
cases.purpose: boundary: fewer contexts than the feature span

cases.name: ngram-blind-spot
cases.purpose: limitation: an out-of-class departure on one never-queried 4-token prompt is undetectable
